# NEW 2026-11-22 v10.0 Worker 3: Playable Jurchen/Manchu Eight Banners & Shanhaiguan (oe_pmch_, Slot 80). Generated by gen_playable_manchu.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# 1. Organize the Eight Banners Niru System (repeatable until banners >= 85, 10y cooldown)
oe_pmch_dec_organize_eight_banners = {
	decision_category = country_specific_decisions
	hide_repeatable_tag = yes
	potential = {
		oe_pmch_is_host = yes
		trigger_if = {
			limit = { has_variable = oe_pmch_banners }
			var:oe_pmch_banners < 85
		}
	}
	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = oe_pmch_player_only_tt
			is_ai = no
		}
		is_subject = no
		gold >= 160
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = oe_pmch_banners_cd_tt
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_pmch_banners_cd }
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { value = 0 }
	illustration_tags = { 10 = armed 10 = exterior }
	illustration_scope = { event_illustration_poptype_effect = { foreground = pop_type:soldiers background = pop_type:nobles } }
	option = {
		name = oe_pmch_dec_organize_eight_banners.a
		effect = {
			custom_tooltip = oe_pmch_dec_organize_eight_banners_tt
			add_gold = -160
			set_variable = { name = oe_pmch_banners_cd value = 1 years = 10 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_pmch_banners_formed value = 1 }
			oe_pmch_add_banners = { amt = 25 }
			add_army_tradition = 8
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_pmch_mod_eight_banners_drill years = 20 mode = replace }
		}
	}
}

# 2. Raise the Ujen Cooha Heavy Cannon Han Banners (up to Tier 4, 10y cooldown)
oe_pmch_dec_raise_ujen_cooha = {
	decision_category = government_decisions
	hide_repeatable_tag = yes
	potential = {
		oe_pmch_is_host = yes
		current_year >= 1580
		trigger_if = {
			limit = { has_variable = oe_pmch_ujen_cooha }
			var:oe_pmch_ujen_cooha < 4
		}
	}
	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = oe_pmch_player_only_tt
			is_ai = no
		}
		is_subject = no
		gold >= 240
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = oe_pmch_ujen_cd_tt
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_pmch_ujen_cd }
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { value = 0 }
	illustration_tags = { 10 = armed 10 = exterior }
	illustration_scope = { event_illustration_poptype_effect = { foreground = pop_type:soldiers background = pop_type:burghers } }
	option = {
		name = oe_pmch_dec_raise_ujen_cooha.a
		effect = {
			custom_tooltip = oe_pmch_dec_raise_ujen_cooha_tt
			add_gold = -240
			set_variable = { name = oe_pmch_ujen_cd value = 1 years = 10 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_pmch_ujen_ready value = 1 }
			oe_pmch_add_ujen = { amt = 1 }
			oe_pmch_add_dual_rule = { amt = 10 }
			add_army_tradition = 8
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_pmch_mod_ujen_cooha_corps years = 25 mode = replace }
			if = {
				limit = { is_situation_active = situation:oe_sit_manchu_pass has_global_variable = oe_pmch_pass_pressure }
				change_global_variable = { name = oe_pmch_pass_pressure add = 12 }
				clamp_global_variable = { name = oe_pmch_pass_pressure min = 0 max = 100 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# 3. Establish the Lifan Yuan & Enact Tan Ding Ru Mu (one-time imperial consolidation)
oe_pmch_dec_establish_lifan_yuan = {
	decision_category = government_decisions
	only_once = yes
	only_once_scope = country
	potential = {
		oe_pmch_is_host = yes
		OR = {
			owns = location:dadu
			num_locations >= 30
		}
		NOT = { has_variable = oe_pmch_dec_lifan_done }
	}
	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = oe_pmch_player_only_tt
			is_ai = no
		}
		is_subject = no
		gold >= 280
		stability >= 0
	}
	ai_will_do = { value = 0 }
	illustration_tags = { 10 = regular 10 = interior }
	illustration_scope = { event_illustration_estate_effect = { foreground = estate_type:crown_estate background = estate_type:nobles_estate } }
	option = {
		name = oe_pmch_dec_establish_lifan_yuan.a
		effect = {
			custom_tooltip = oe_pmch_dec_establish_lifan_yuan_tt
			add_gold = -280
			set_variable = { name = oe_pmch_dec_lifan_done value = 1 }
			oe_pmch_add_dual_rule = { amt = 20 }
			add_stability = 5
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_pmch_mod_lifan_tanding years = 40 mode = replace }
		}
	}
}
